title: Quick Custom Menu plugin - create any menus during the game.

posts.author: Pheonix KageDesu
posts.body:
Quick Custom Menu
Pheonix KageDesu
​
Plugin allowing you to quickly create radial menus with different options. The options have many flexible settings, so you can completely customize them yourself. Menu support mouse, keyboard and gamepad inputs, and are based on a new interface system (NUI) that supports all screen resolutions and very customizable. It can be used widely in various genres.
Features:
- You can create a quick radial menu with your own options.
- A lot of settings for each menu options.
- Modify menu during game (remove or add options, or whole menus)
- Full customization of the appearance (via the NUI system)
- Full gamepad support (Touch, Mouse, keyboard as well)
- Automatic adjustment to the screen resolution
Plugin works with RPG Maker MZ and MV.​
How to Use:
Plugin have Demo project with examples and Guide.
Plugin webpage
Download:
Download from MEGA (select Quick Custom Menu folder)
